items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: You worked with him? ... Well, we did his first theater date.

ctx.x: ... Fats Waller had a tune called 'Stealin' See Them Apples.' So that my chorus, the out chorus was my chorus. It was a hit arrangement.
... somebody that I think never gotten enough credit

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Fats Waller as a 'tremendous personality' and notes a gig, but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond with any personal anecdote, connection, or confirmation of meeting him.

ctx.x: The Fats Fats Waller. And he's a tremendous personality so we had another gig. We go down to Atlantic City and it's the first time the musicians are on time. Musicians are never on time, you know. Guys I know ain't never on time but sometimes
